summary: Verified iter52 formatApiError bug fix for the 'Objects are not valid as a React child' crash in ManualTraceOverlay. Backend confirmed to return detail=[{type,loc,msg,input,ctx}] on 422 (exact crash-shape). Frontend now stringifies it: rendered 'Input should be a valid list; Input should be a valid dictionary' with NO React crash and overlay stayed mounted. String-detail 400 path also renders as-is ('No valid walls provided'). Prior iter51 testids all still present (svg, count 28 walls, snap, undo, clear, save, close, bf-w, bf-h).
critical_code_review_comments: formatApiError() in ManualTraceOverlay.jsx handles all 4 shapes correctly: string, array-of-Pydantic-objs, single object, and fallback to err.message. Defensive render fallback in the error banner (`typeof error === 'string' ? error : formatApiError(...)`) is a nice belt-and-suspenders.

DocumentsTab.jsx openTrace catch inlines the same 3-branch stringification (string / array / object) instead of importing formatApiError. Minor DRY concern — consider exporting formatApiError from ManualTraceOverlay.jsx (or a shared util) so both paths stay in sync.

The rest of DocumentsTab.jsx still calls `e?.response?.data?.detail` directly in the retry-all and delete alerts (lines ~317, 497, 612). Those endpoints currently only return string detail so no crash, but if any of them ever start returning Pydantic 422s the same crash could recur. Low priority.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (both 422 and 400 error paths render cleanly, overlay stays mounted, no React child crash)

seed_data_creation: Reused existing TEST_iter48_perpage project with 2 done+synced docs. Live browser test used page.route interception to force 422 and 400 responses without mutating backend state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified end-to-end via live UI test on production preview URL. The exact crash-shape (FastAPI 422 with detail as list of Pydantic error objects) was intercepted via page.route and returned to the running overlay — result was a human-readable joined string with no crash, no [object Object]. String-detail 400 path also intact. iter51 backend contract still fully covered.
rca of the issue: N/A — targeted fix already verified working. Root cause of the original bug (unchanged): FastAPI 422 responses expose `detail` as `list[dict]` per Pydantic v2. React cannot render objects as children, so `{error}` where error was set to the raw array crashed the reconciler. Fix: formatApiError() joins the list by '; ' using each item's .msg. Live-verified renderable output: 'Input should be a valid list; Input should be a valid dictionary'.
